test_linear_layer: test the networks linear layer by transforming with haiku and verifying weight and bias parameter shapes
test_conv_layer: test the networks conv layer by transforming with haiku and verifying kernel and bias parameter shapes
test_linear_with_shared_bias: test the networks linear_with_shared_bias layer to verify all outputs share a single scalar bias parameter
test_noisy_linear_layer: test the networks noisy_linear layer to verify it produces different outputs for different RNG keys
test_noisy_linear_sigma_params: test the networks noisy_linear sigma parameters are constant values scaled by noise scale over sqrt of input size
